content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary objective includes two populations but primary endpoint analysis only specified for SCC first",
      "quote": "To compare OS for patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer who have histology of squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) and who have any eligible histology",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "2.1 Primary Objective",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective mentions both SCC and any eligible histology, but the statistical section only details the primary analysis in SCC patients first, with no explicit analysis plan for the overall population beyond a statement of higher power.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis method and testing procedure for OS in the overall population (e.g., hierarchical testing after SCC)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack analysis methods for DOR and QOL",
      "quote": "Other secondary endpoints will include DOR and QOL. Duration of response will be defined as the time between the date of first response (CR or PR) to the date of the first documented tumor progression (per RECIST 1.1) or death due to any cause. Quality of life will be measured by the EORTC QLQ-C30.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "4.2.3 Other Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The endpoints DOR and QOL are defined but no statistical analysis methods are provided for them in the statistical plan section.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for DOR (e.g., Kaplan-Meier, stratified log-rank) and QOL (e.g., mixed model for repeated measures, change from baseline)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "To measure concentrations of cemiplimab in serum and characterize the pharmacokinetics (PK) of cemiplimab",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.3 Exploratory Objectives",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Exploratory objectives (PK, immunogenicity, biomarkers, pharmacodynamics) are listed but no analysis methods are described in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Include a section describing the planned analyses for PK, ADA, biomarkers, and pharmacodynamic endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is OS, defined as the time from randomization to the date of death. A patient who has not died will be censored at the last known date of contact.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "4.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for OS lacks explicit specification of intercurrent events (e.g., use of subsequent therapy) and summary measure (e.g., hazard ratio) in the endpoint definition.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes: population, variable, intercurrent events handling, and summary measure (e.g., hazard ratio from stratified log-rank)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for endpoints",
      "quote": "Data collected regarding the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the patients will be summarized (eg, discontinuation due to COVID-19). Any additional analyses and methods required to investigate the impact of COVID-19 on the efficacy (eg, missing data due to COVID-19) and safety evaluation will be specified in the SAP.",
      "page": 93,
      "section": "10 STATISTICAL PLAN",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan defers missing data handling to the SAP, but no general missing data strategy is provided for primary or secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Specify the primary approach for missing data (e.g., censoring rules for time-to-event, multiple imputation for QOL) in the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity control not fully specified for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are PFS and ORR.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe how type I error is controlled across multiple secondary endpoints (PFS, ORR, DOR, QOL) beyond the primary OS testing.",
      "fix": "Describe the hierarchical testing procedure or other multiplicity adjustment for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency: 590 total projected but only 460 SCC randomized",
      "quote": "At the time when 460 SCC patients are enrolled in the study, a total enrollment in the study of approximately 590 patients is projected (SCC plus non-SCC).",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "10.2 Justification of Sample Size",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size section states 460 SCC patients yield 340 events, but the total enrollment of 590 is not clearly linked to power for the overall population analysis.",
      "fix": "Clarify the power and event assumptions for the overall population analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for safety endpoints",
      "quote": "To evaluate the safety and tolerability of cemiplimab IC chemotherapy, the incidence of AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), deaths, and laboratory abnormalities will be assessed.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "4.2.3 Other Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Safety endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis methods (e.g., descriptive statistics, confidence intervals) are provided in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing the statistical analysis of safety data (e.g., frequency tables, exposure-adjusted rates)."
    }
  ]
}
